statement: The pinned Singer client maps separately labelled MIDI channels 0,1,2,3 to output0x83 selectors 4,3,1,0 respectively. Its same MIDI note pair produces frequency fields 226/450 for channels0/1 and 220/440 for channels2/3, all gain-20. The owner experienced the pairs on grip channels with some audibility and felt the pad-channel pairs with little audibility. Exact left/right actuator location was not independently qualified; source-named selector meanings, calibrated pitch, loudness and MIDI interface semantics are not promoted.
